SELECT
  pop.status AS order_status,
  pop.order_count,
  ROUND(pop.order_count * 100.0 / SUM(pop.order_count) OVER (), 1) AS pct_of_orders,
  ROUND(pop.grand_total_eur, 2) AS orders_grand_total_eur,
  pop.orders_with_captured_payment_count,
  ROUND(COALESCE(pay.captured_eur, 0), 2) AS matched_captured_payment_eur,
  ROUND(pop.grand_total_eur - COALESCE(pay.captured_eur, 0), 2) AS gap_eur,
  ROUND((pop.grand_total_eur - COALESCE(pay.captured_eur, 0)) / NULLIF(pop.grand_total_eur, 0) * 100, 1) AS gap_pct
FROM (
  SELECT
    o.status,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count,
    SUM(o.grand_total / er.rate) AS grand_total_eur,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id = o.id AND p.status = 'captured'
    ) THEN 1 END) AS orders_with_captured_payment_count
  FROM orders o
  JOIN exchange_rates er
    ON er.base_code = 'EUR'
   AND er.quote_code = o.currency_code
   AND er.as_of = CAST(o.placed_at AS date)
  WHERE o.placed_at >= DATE '2023-01-01'
    AND o.placed_at < DATE '2025-07-01'
  GROUP BY o.status
) pop
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    o.status,
    SUM(p.amount / er2.rate) AS captured_eur
  FROM payments p
  JOIN orders o ON o.id = p.order_id
  JOIN exchange_rates er2
    ON er2.base_code = 'EUR'
   AND er2.quote_code = p.currency_code
   AND er2.as_of = CAST(p.captured_at AS date)
  WHERE p.status = 'captured'
    AND o.placed_at >= DATE '2023-01-01'
    AND o.placed_at < DATE '2025-07-01'
  GROUP BY o.status
) pay ON pay.status = pop.status
ORDER BY orders_grand_total_eur DESC, pop.status
note: Grain is order status, population restricted to orders placed 2023-01-01 through 2025-06-30 inclusive as requested. EUR conversion divides each amount by the EUR→currency rate (orders by placed_at date, captured payments by captured_at date), matching the convention that exchange_rates.rate is EUR-based.
